name: ui-send-morph
title: Send Morph
description: Bấm GỬI, nút co thành hình tròn, một chiếc máy bay giấy hiện ra, lùi lấy đà rồi vút bay chéo lên khỏi khung, nút chuyển xanh với dấu tích rồi giãn lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.press: s the button is clicked (0.3); the rest follows its own timing
options.bulge: px the curve sags below the straight line (104)
options.pull: px the plane pulls back first (16)
options.label: the label
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Pill 140x46 → circle 46 (0.38-0.68 s power2.inOut); 'SEND' fades 0.36-0.46 s. Paper plane pops in (0.62-0.74 s back.out), pulls back 4 px (0.1 s power1.out), flies 0.84-1.32 s power2.in on a curve 158 px right and 74 px up (bulging 26 px below the straight line), turned along its path, 4 fading trail dots. 1.5 s fill turns green with a 1.12 pop, tick draws 1.6-1.85 s. 2.3-2.65 s width back to 140 (power2.out), 'SEND' returns. Params: width (140 → 46 px) · fly (0.48 s, power2.in) · path (158 px ngang, 74 px lên) · success (1.5 s).
